name: Portable Folding Camping Moon Chair - 63cm Wide Seat, Heavy Duty Carbon Steel, 300 lbs Capacity
description:
Experience ultimate comfort outdoors with our Premium Folding Camping Moon Chair. Featuring an extra-wide 63cm seat and ergonomic crescent design, this chair provides exceptional support for camping, fishing, picnics, and backyard gatherings.

Key Features:

  • Extra-wide 63cm seat for maximum comfort
  • Heavy-duty carbon steel frame supports up to 300 lbs
  • Durable 600D Oxford fabric with breathable mesh
  • Quick fold design - sets up in seconds
  • Lightweight at only 2.5kg for easy transport
  • Side pocket for phone, keys, and small items
  • Carry bag included
short_description: Premium folding camping moon chair with 63cm extra-wide seat, heavy-duty carbon steel frame supports 300 lbs. Quick fold, lightweight, perfect for camping, fishing, and outdoor adventures.
